structured_output.summary: The implementation follows RFC 9110 ordering and covers the acceptance criteria. Remaining gaps are minor. No existing tests were weakened.

findings.text: No test covers If-Match or If-None-Match against a response with no etag set, or an If-None-Match list with several tags.
apply_range tests for a zero-length body and for a direct_passthrough iterable with a known Content-Length only assert headers, not that the sliced body data is correct.
